tools.description: Use this managed path for every new image or video request when ComfyUI automation is enabled, including ordinary images. Discover starter paths with comfy_catalog, import and revise them with comfy_workflow, then use the returned executable workflow objects as preview_workflow and final_workflow. API links are two-element arrays [source_node_id, output_index], never omitted or replaced with output names. The optional inputs array binds only local image/audio/video source files to upload widgets using absolute paths; checkpoint/model names stay in the graphs and are not source bindings. Optional expected_outputs, preview_expected_outputs and final_expected_outputs contain output node IDs such as node 25; stage-specific lists override expected_outputs, and an empty effective list infers graph output nodes. Set file names in output node inputs. Read comfy_status for effective limits and configuration.quality_preference; honor that default when quality is omitted. When video duration is omitted, propose a motion draft of about five seconds. Choose playable MP4 with H.264 for final video using discovered output node contracts unless the operator requests a supported alternative format or codec. Preserve that supported alternative and save the format in the final graph before preview approval; a later format change requires a new preview and approval. Do not apply a universal output-format rewrite to unknown graphs. Start stage=preview with both graphs and an absolute output_directory. For an image preview, call image_read with the verified preview image artifact.path to display its larger bounded image before requesting approval; the job-status thumbnail alone is insufficient. Successful decoding verifies readable media, not the requested subject or motion quality. Before describing video content or quality, call image_analyze with the path of the published artifact whose role is sampled_video_contact_sheet, then poll reviewer_status for actual findings. Report unavailable contact sheets and review failures with their actual errors; limit visual claims to reviewed sampled frames and do not claim unverified motion quality or repeat the prompt as observed content. For a verified video preview or final artifact with provider_view_url, call browser_open with that exact URL while ComfyUI is running, then use desktop_read on the observed browser window to check its actual address. Launch acceptance alone does not verify page loading or playback. Report actual browser-launch or observation failures. Present the URL as a copyable reference and the complete artifacts[].path in a copyable fenced block; LM Studio 0.4.26+4's ordinary Markdown link path rejects loopback URLs. Never abbreviate file paths. Retain the sampled-frame preview. Poll comfy_job_status, present its actual preview and approval_reply_choices, and wait for a later native user approval before stage=final with plan_id only. Never use image_generate, direct HTTP, shell or browser queue submission for these requests. Uncertain submissions are never replayed.

expected_outputs.description: Exact output node IDs used for both stages when a stage-specific list is absent. For example, ["25"] selects graph node 25. Omit or use [] to infer all graph nodes whose discovered schema marks them as output nodes. Set file names in the output node inputs.

final_expected_outputs.description: Exact output node IDs in final_workflow, overriding expected_outputs for the final render. For example, ["25"] selects final graph node 25. Omit this field to use expected_outputs; an empty effective list infers all final output nodes. Set file names in the output node inputs.

preview_expected_outputs.description: Exact output node IDs in preview_workflow, overriding expected_outputs for the preview. For example, ["25"] selects preview graph node 25. Omit this field to use expected_outputs; an empty effective list infers all preview output nodes. Set file names in the output node inputs.

tools.name: comfy_run

tools.description: Read ComfyUI automation configuration, installation, readiness, GPU observations and setup limits without starting the server. When configuration.enabled is true, every new image or video request must use comfy_run with a saved preview/final plan and native preview approval. Start an unavailable provider with comfy_control or automatic setup, then discover node contracts and starter workflows with comfy_catalog; do not switch to legacy image_generate after starting ComfyUI.
tools.name: comfy_status

tools.description: Preflight an arbitrary executable ComfyUI graph against installed node contracts and expected output nodes without enqueueing generation. expected_outputs contains graph output node IDs such as node 25; omit it to infer output nodes. Set file names in output node inputs. Provider validation at actual submission remains authoritative.

expected_outputs.description: Exact output node IDs in workflow. For example, ["25"] selects graph node 25. Omit or use [] to infer all graph nodes whose discovered schema marks them as output nodes. Set file names in the output node inputs.

tools.name: comfy_validate

tools.description: Import a discovered template or local workflow through its absolute path, inspect it, revise node inputs with typed patches, or export it. The returned workflow is executable API JSON for comfy_validate and comfy_run; preserve its node connections as [source_node_id, output_index] arrays. Use typed modify patches for prompts, selected installed models and draft/final settings rather than reconstructing a graph from memory. UI imports retain ui_workflow and use the installed frontend serializer. File paths require current project authority; conversion errors remain explicit. These operations do not submit generation.
tools.name: comfy_workflow
